nodes.fact: EAU can revise a hybrid user simulator that combines symbolic rules and LLM responses.
EAU can adapt environment behavior and feedback during training.
EAU can revise reward design during reinforcement learning.
EAU can change reinforcement-learning configuration during a run.
EAU adapts within a training run and carries experience across runs.
EAU is evaluated on UserGym, ColBench, and τ²-bench.
EAU is evaluated with Qwen3-4B and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct policy backbones.
On Qwen3-4B, EAU reports 0.600 ColBench task success, a 36.7% relative gain over InfoPO.
